description.value: Pizzeria Ludica is a distinctive New Westminster restaurant pairing thin-crust stone-oven pizza with hundreds of board and card games, all free to play with a meal order. Located steps from Columbia SkyTrain station, it draws locals and visitors alike with a broad game library colour-coded by complexity. The restaurant offers a separate vegan menu and accepts walk-ins, making it an accessible and unhurried stop.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 26m; stands (8 spaces) at 31m; stands (8 spaces) at 37m; stands (2 spaces) at 50m; stands (8 spaces) at 53m. Total: 28 spaces.

No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or device-charging information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: No bike parking information available on website or in OSM tags — the key required WWC criterion cannot be confirmed.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Pizzeria Ludica is a legitimate, operating restaurant well-suited to cyclists in terms of food variety and SkyTrain proximity, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct inquiry is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website contact page notes the restaurant is near Columbia SkyTrain station, which may be relevant for cyclists combining transit and riding. Parking info (paid street/underground until 8 pm, free after) is for vehicles only.
